name: functionId
label: Function ID
description: Sys ID of the mobile function that should be invoked. Mobile functions are found in the sys_sg_button table.

name: table
label: Table
description: Table to invoke the function on. Required for functions with record context.

name: recordId
label: Record ID
description: Sys ID of the record from the given table to invoke the function on. Required for functions with record context.
